heading: Deadline
text: You must return the SNAP redetermination form by November 12, 2026.

heading: Documents
text: You must submit proof of income and proof of address.

heading: Method
text: You must upload the documents through the benefits portal.

heading: Consequence
text: Failure to respond will close the benefits case.

heading: Appeal
text: You must request a fair hearing by December 2, 2026.

heading: Terms
text: Redetermination means a review of whether you still qualify.

heading: Contact
text: You must contact your caseworker if you need help.
